WITH q AS (SELECT p.id,p.order_no AS business_key,p.order_status,p.amount,p.paid_amount,p.purchase_order_no,p.batch_no,(SELECT COALESCE(SUM(d.pay_amount),0) FROM ol_order.payment_order_paydetail d WHERE d.pay_order_no=p.order_no AND COALESCE(d.is_delete,0)=0 AND COALESCE(d.is_cancel,0)=0) AS detail_paid,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ol_order.payment_order d WHERE d.order_no=p.order_no AND COALESCE(d.is_delete,0)=0 AND COALESCE(d.is_cancel,0)=0) AS duplicate_n,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ol_order.purchase_order d WHERE d.order_no=p.purchase_order_no AND COALESCE(d.is_delete,0)=0 AND COALESCE(d.is_cancel,0)=0) AS source_n,(SELECT MIN(d.purchase_price) FROM ol_order.purchase_order d WHERE d.order_no=p.purchase_order_no AND COALESCE(d.is_delete,0)=0 AND COALESCE(d.is_cancel,0)=0) AS source_amount FROM ol_order.payment_order p WHERE p.id BETWEEN :startId AND :endId AND COALESCE(p.is_delete,0)=0 AND COALESCE(p.is_cancel,0)=0 AND (:startDateTime IS NULL OR p.create_time>=:startDateTime) AND (:endExclusiveDateTime IS NULL OR p.create_time<:endExclusiveDateTime))

WITH q AS (SELECT p.id,p.payment_no AS business_key,p.status,p.payment_result,p.amount,p.pay_amount,p.payment_serial_no,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM lease_finance.payment_order d WHERE d.payment_no=p.payment_no AND COALESCE(d.is_delete,0)=0 AND COALESCE(d.is_cancel,0)=0) AS duplicate_n FROM lease_finance.payment_order p WHERE p.id BETWEEN :startId AND :endId AND COALESCE(p.is_delete,0)=0 AND COALESCE(p.is_cancel,0)=0 AND (:startDateTime IS NULL OR p.create_time>=:startDateTime) AND (:endExclusiveDateTime IS NULL OR p.create_time<:endExclusiveDateTime))
